headings.font: Outfit, Clash Display, or Playfair Display
headings.style: Premium, structural, and uppercase for section titles. Use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for large headings to mimic architectural precision.

body.style: Clean, highly legible, modern sans-serif. Loose line-height (leading-relaxed).

visual_enhancers: Subtle noise/grain overlay spanning the entire site for physical depth.
1px structural grid lines in subtle white/grey opacity (border-white/10).
Optical clarity glassmorphism for sticky navigation (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60).
Avoid standard box-shadows. Use sharp architectural borders.

components.name: Kinetic Hero
components.instructions: Full viewport height. Use Framer Motion to animate large typography ('YOU DREAM. WE BUILD.'). Wrap text lines in 'overflow-hidden' divs and animate inner 'motion.h1' from y: '100%' to y: 0. Stagger the lines for a cinematic reveal.

components.name: Editorial Marquee
components.instructions: Use 'react-fast-marquee'. Extremely slow speed. Use massive outline text (text-transparent stroke-white/20) traversing horizontally.

components.name: Manifesto Chapters
components.instructions: Vertical list of numbered principles (e.g. 01, 02). As user scrolls, use Framer Motion 'whileInView' to reveal text and number. High contrast numbers in accent_orange or concrete_grey.

components.name: Project Index & Filter
components.instructions: Grid-based or list-based layout. Include a filter toggle for 'Completed (13)' vs 'Ongoing (6)'. DO NOT use actual building images. Use solid blocks of charcoal/beige or the provided concrete textures as placeholders with the project name overlaid beautifully.

components.name: Project Detail Template
components.instructions: Reusable layout. Large abstract header area, modular grid for stats (Location, Status, Type) with concrete lines, and ample whitespace.

components.name: Navigation
components.instructions: Desktop: Fixed/Sticky with backdrop-blur. Logo left, links center, 'LET'S TALK ->' CTA on right in accent color. Mobile: Hamburger opening a full-screen Framer Motion overlay (100vh).

components.name: Design-Only Contact Form
components.instructions: Minimalist fields (border-b only, no full boxes). Deep architectural feel. Use Shadcn inputs with custom styling.

grids_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-24, or p-32 for section padding. Negative space is a feature.
grids_layouts.alignment: Strict architectural grid. Break standard symmetry. Use 'Tetris' grid modes (col-span-8, col-span-4) for visual tension.

motion_and_animations.smooth_scroll: Wrap the app root in ReactLenis from '@studio-freight/react-lenis' for premium physics.
motion_and_animations.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion 'whileInView' with 'viewport={{ once: true, margin: "-100px" }}'.
motion_and_animations.parallax: Use 'useScroll' and 'useTransform' for a subtle hero background parallax or 3D float moment.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text passes APCA contrast ratios against the dark backgrounds.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion' via Framer Motion's useReducedMotion hook.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='nav-contact-button').

media.strategy: Minimal abstract placeholders. NO fake building imagery, hard-hats, or apartment stocks.

instructions_to_main_agent: Run `yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis react-fast-marquee react-router-dom lucide-react`.
Replace default boilerplate in `src/App.js` with a HashRouter/BrowserRouter setup containing Home, Projects, About, Contact, and ProjectDetail routes.
Implement the kinetic line-by-line reveal in the Home hero section. This is a hard requirement for the Awwwards feel.
Mock the 19 projects data (13 completed, 6 ongoing) in a reusable data file (e.g., `src/data/projects.js`).
Use solid color rectangles with the project title overlaid OR the provided concrete/abstract textures as project placeholders.
Ensure 'LET'S TALK' CTA is highly visible in nav.
Apply smooth scrolling using Lenis to the entire app root.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use generic centered text alignment globally.
DO NOT use generic gradients or standard blue SaaS colors. Stick to the premium deep charcoal, concrete, beige, and orange palette.
Use 2-3x more padding than usual (e.g., py-24 or py-32 for sections).
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (MUST DO).
Implement subtle hover states (e.g., slightly changing border color, opacity, or a small y-translate).
NEVER use generic placeholder imagery or dummy text loops. Use provided abstract architectural textures.
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
